name: mordred-fated-luminary-graveyard-attack-card-floats-for-memory-cost
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): "Attack cards in your graveyard have floating memory and 'Ephemerate -- (X)'." (While paying a memory cost you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.) FIXED (was: the graveyard attack card never floated; this fixture used to be ...-graveyard-attack-card-never-floats-for-memory-cost and pinned the refusal 'Cannot pay costs for the selected material card. Action undone.'). Root cause: HasFloatingMemory() (Custom/GameLogic.php) granted the Fated Luminary floating memory only when isset($obj->Controller), but a graveyard object has no persisted Controller (the Graveyard zone class serializes only CardID; it carries just PlayerID), so every graveyard card parsed back from the game state failed the check. Fix: the owner is resolved by the new FloatingMemoryOwner() (graveyard objects -> PlayerID). The champion is Fated Luminary, the graveyard holds a Striking Tides, and the two seeded memory cards are one short of the memory cost 3 of the same-level level-up into Aurelian Regent: the REAL level-up is offered the floating payment, Striking Tides is banished for 1 point and the two memory cards pay the rest. This is the 'USE a floated graveyard card' proof for Fated Luminary.

rulesClauses: Attack cards in your graveyard have floating memory (a floating card pays 1 of a memory cost).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Fated Luminary's floating-memory grant never applied to graveyard cards parsed back from the game state: HasFloatingMemory() granted it only when isset($obj->Controller), but the Graveyard zone class serializes only CardID and carries just PlayerID. Fix: new FloatingMemoryOwner() resolves a graveyard object's owner through PlayerID (field/stack objects keep Controller) and HasFloatingMemory() uses it for the Fated Luminary branch.
